content:
maya: heads-up — ran into an SDK vs REST mismatch in the quickstart sample. The JS SDK doesn't expose the /v1/models/:id/metrics endpoint we call in the tutorial. quickstart fails at the first eval step :bug:

sam: ah — which SDK version?

maya: redwood-js@0.5.1 in npm. The REST example in docs shows: GET /v1/models/{id}/metrics?window=1h but the SDK has no equivalent method or helper.

kevin: hmm we intentionally kept telemetry endpoints server-side, but that sounds like a docs drift. Docs should call the telemetry helper in the SDK or update the REST example.

olivia: I also noticed param name drift: SDK's generation call uses "temp" while REST uses "temperature". Leads to silent fallbacks (defaults apply) and confusing outputs. Anyone seen silent auth/retry behavior too? :eyes:

maya: yes — sample app retried 401s twice and then returned a generic error message. From local logs: 
```
POST /sdk/generate -> 401 -> SDK retry (backoff) -> 401 -> surface "Request failed" to user
```
No clear error about missing/invalid key, which slows onboarding.

sam: that's bad for dev experience. The SDK should not auto-retry 401; only 429/5xx. And it should surface the original 401 with guidance (e.g., "check REDWOOD_API_KEY env var").

kevin: agreed. Workaround is to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in env and add explicit check in sample app, but the SDK should do the right thing.

olivia: also a minor one — the types in TypeScript typings declare "modelId" required for listModels, but the REST API returns models without that param. Type confusion again.

maya: here's the failing snippet from the quickstart (JS):
```
const client = new RedwoodClient()
const metrics = await client.models.getMetrics({ modelId: 'redwood-v1', window: '1h' })
```
This throws: "getMetrics is not a function"

sam: we should either add getMetrics to redwood-js or update quickstart to use the REST helper. I'll open an issue.

kevin: +1. Also log: SDK docs mention automatic retries for network errors but the retry policy isn't configurable via client options — we should expose retryPolicy { maxRetries, retryOn } so apps can opt out of 401 retries.

maya: onboarding friction note: the quickstart README references env var RN_API_KEY (typo) while SDK looks for REDWOOD_API_KEY. New users hit a 401 and then the SDK masks it by retrying. Tricky.

olivia: I'll PR a small patch to quickstart README and add an explicit credentials check in the sample app. Sam — can you follow up on adding a non-retrying path for auth failures in the SDK?

sam: will do. I'll file two issues: one for adding getMetrics parity and one for retry behavior and config.

dev-bot: created issues #4235 (sdk: add models.getMetrics) and #4236 (sdk: retry policy + don't retry 401).

maya: thanks. One more request — can we add a short troubleshooting snippet in the docs to call out common parity/drift gotchas (param names, env var names, types)? Would have saved us 30+ mins. :thinking:

kevin: good idea. I'll add a doc section "SDK vs REST parity checklist" and link to the issues.

sam: assigning myself to #4236 and pinging eng-platform for review.

olivia: ping @kevin for the docs PR when ready.

maya: appreciated — I'll update the quickstart repo with the env var fix now.
